seo.title: Cabinet Care & Maintenance Plans
seo.description: Annual care plans that keep your glide-out shelves and cabinet hardware working like new, plus a lifetime warranty on the hardware we install.

image.alt: Close detail of a soft-close glide-out shelf runner

sections.heading: Cabinet care & maintenance plans.
sections.body: Keep your glide-out shelves gliding and your soft-close closing. Our care plans keep the hardware we fit running like new year after year, so a decade of daily use never turns into a callout you did not budget for.

sections.heading: Keep your cabinets running at their best.
sections.intro: Regular care keeps runners level, dampers quiet and drawers tracking true, and it catches wear before it becomes a repair. We offer three plans to fit how much cabinetry you have and how hard it works.

tiers.name: Basic care
tiers.note: One kitchen or a single room of cabinets

tiers.name: Standard care
tiers.note: A larger kitchen with a pantry or closets

sections.footnote: Plans cover the glide-out and soft-close hardware we supplied and installed. The lifetime glide warranty applies whether or not you take a plan; a plan adds scheduled visits, tune-ups and the discounts above.

sections.heading: Start a care plan today.
sections.body: Keep your cabinets working like the day they were fitted, and skip the surprise repair. Call the shop or start online and we will match you to the right plan.

items.question: What is included in a cabinet care plan?
items.answer: Every plan includes a scheduled inspection of the cabinets and hardware we installed, re-levelling of any runners that have drifted, and a discount on any repair. Higher plans add soft-close tune-ups, damper replacement and priority booking.

items.question: Can I upgrade my plan later?
items.answer: Yes. You can move up a plan at any time and we credit the unused part of your current plan against the new one. Most people start on Basic and move up when they add cabinetry.

items.question: Do I need a plan for the warranty to apply?
items.answer: No. The lifetime glide warranty covers the hardware we supplied and installed whether or not you take a plan. A plan adds scheduled visits, tune-ups and discounts on top of the warranty.

items.question: Is there a cancellation fee?
items.answer: None. You can cancel a care plan whenever you like, and we refund the unused portion of the year. The warranty on the hardware we fitted stays in place regardless.
